name: scheduling
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when scheduling moves to a different clock source (e.g. a native plugin cron API) or when the tick interval/route become config-driven and this slice's hardcoding is removed.
spec_change_reason: Fix _reconcile_ledger_seed's malformed issue_ref. The live producer's work_order_id uses a -wo SUFFIX (owner/repo#N-wo), but the seed stripped only a legacy wo- PREFIX, leaving issue_ref=owner/repo#N-wo so `gh issue view N-wo` (issue_ref.split('#')[-1]) failed every tick, breaking RECONCILE's (A) merged-PR issue-close. _reconcile_ledger_seed now derives the CANONICAL owner/repo#N by stripping the wo- prefix (dry-run producer) OR the -wo suffix (live producer), else the id as-is; repo is the owner/repo before #. The pr_ref URL->owner/repo#N canonicalization from the prior wave is unchanged, and there is no verify-integrate change. Re-anchored the housekeep spec.md baseline 1462->1471 for the already-committed 0.46.0 spec growth (contract.md kept under its strictly-grew gate).
spec_no_change_reason: Spec already updated for this cycle in commit 3e3c4e4 (spec(scheduling): in-flight exclusion, already_done, terminal-resolved skip); no further spec change needed this transition.
